text: All data must be hosted in the United Kingdom.
The supplier must hold Cyber Essentials Plus certification.
The supplier must comply with UK GDPR and sign the University's Data Processing Agreement.
Conversation transcripts must be retained for no longer than 90 days, and the retention period must be configurable by the University.
The University must be able to manage its own encryption keys.
The supplier should provide the full report of its most recent independent penetration test to the University.
The solution should be able to run on the University's own on-premises servers if required.
Students and staff must sign in through single sign-on using our Microsoft Entra ID tenant.
User accounts must be provisioned and removed automatically through SCIM.
The assistant must answer questions using the University's policies, which are held in SharePoint, and the content of our public website.
Every answer must include links to the source documents used.
When the assistant cannot answer, it must hand the conversation to a human adviser together with the conversation history.
The assistant must provide its full service to students in both English and Welsh.
The administration interface used by Student Services staff should also be available in Welsh.
Staff must be able to use the assistant inside Microsoft Teams.
The student-facing interface must meet WCAG 2.2 AA.
The assistant should be embedded in our Moodle virtual learning environment.
The assistant should also integrate with Blackboard Learn, which is used by our partner colleges.
Student Services should see analytics on the most common question topics and on questions the assistant could not answer.
The service must be available at least 99.5% of the time each month.
The service must support at least 10,000 concurrent conversations during enrolment week.
The supplier should deliver face-to-face training for 25 Student Services staff at our Cardiff campus.
The supplier must provide at least one reference from a higher education customer.
At the end of the contract the supplier must delete all University data and provide a certificate of deletion.
